- ADV-4: active data owner switches between receipt INSERT and outbox DELETE → transaction rolled back, no cross-owner receipt, no open transaction; owner switch while the request is in flight → ack not applied to owner A, owner B drains only its own row.

- ADV-6: backend answers AFTER API_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS (fake timers) — typed 408 timeout, row retained, late acceptance cannot mutate durable state, next healthy drain completes exactly once.
- ADV-7: lying acknowledgements — unknown accepted id, duplicate accepted id, same id accepted+rejected, partial ack, acceptedIds as string, empty object, rejected entry without/with non-string code, non-string rejected id → sync.invalid_acknowledgement, no receipt, no delete, no exhaustion, other owner isolated; per-item rejection: transient shot.write_failed stays queued while permanent access.permit_not_reserved exhausts.
